one_liner: Integrate tools, automate actions, and customize workflows with Asana's developer platform and REST API.
auth_notes: Supports Personal Access Tokens (PAT), Service Account tokens, and OAuth.
gate_notes: Developer sandbox allows testing premium features not included in a free account.
verdict_reason: Asana provides a fully documented REST API with self-serve token generation (PAT) and OAuth support, making it readily buildable.

evidence.quote: The primary feature of Asana’s platform is our rest API, so we recommend getting familiar with how our API works.
Choose your authentication method. Your app may ultimately use OAuth, but most developers test our API by creating a Personal Access Token (PAT) to make their first API calls.
Choose your test workspace. You can test in any of your existing workspaces, create a free account, or request a developer sandbox.
Automate tedious work in powerful, bespoke ways with our platform features like rule actions, webhooks, and our API.
New to the Asana API? Build your first app with our step by step quick start guide. Learn to create and authorize with a token then create tasks via the API.
